title: No live per-host status during multi-host runs; parallel output interleaves into one text box
existing_state: During a run the only feedback is the single output TextBox plus a status-bar percentage (BeginManualExecutionProgress, Form1.cs:12384-12388). Form1 never subscribes the service's ProgressChanged event at all (event wiring at Form1.cs:362-371 covers 8 events, not ProgressChanged). With parallel hosts, ExecuteFolderAsync runs batch hosts concurrently (SshExecutionService.cs:697, 888) and each host's session streams chunks via OnOutputReceived as they arrive, so the live pane interleaves output from N hosts with no per-host routing — the per-host view (with pass/fail icons) only materializes after the run completes, via StoreExecutionHistory and the history host pane (Form1.cs:8299-8322). At 200 hosts there is no way to see mid-run which hosts are queued/running/failed, or to triage early failures while the run continues.
recommendation: Add a live run panel (reuse the lstHosts owner-draw pattern, Form1.cs:8541) listing target hosts with state icons (queued/running/ok/failed), fed by ProgressChanged + per-host completion inside ExecuteFolderAsync (it already computes per-host results at SshExecutionService.cs:884-890; raise a HostCompleted event there). Optionally color grid rows live using the existing connection-test visual-state infrastructure (Form1.cs:2687-2721). Selecting a host in the panel can filter the live output by that host once chunks are tagged with e.Host (already on the event args).
user_benefit: On long fleet runs you can watch failures accumulate in real time and start triaging immediately, instead of staring at interleaved text and waiting for the history entry to appear.

evidence.note: concurrent batch hosts stream OnOutputReceived chunks that interleave in the single output box
per-host status pane exists only post-run via history payload

mockup_idea: Run-in-progress view: left panel listing hosts with spinner/check/X icons and counts ('137 done · 4 failed · 9 running · 50 queued'), right side the existing output box filtered to the clicked host.
